title: Welcome to BlogEngine
body:
This is your first post in BlogEngine!

BlogEngine is a powerful CLI tool for managing blog posts. You can create, edit, search, and organize your posts right from your terminal.

Try these commands:
- 'list' to see all posts
- 'new' to create a post
- 'search' to find posts
- 'help' for more commands

title: Getting Started with Elixir
body:
Elixir is a dynamic, functional language designed for building scalable and maintainable applications.

Key features:
- Functional programming paradigm
- Pattern matching
- Concurrent and distributed
- Runs on the Erlang VM (BEAM)
- Great for web development with Phoenix

If you're new to Elixir, check out the official guides at elixir-lang.org!

title: My Favorite Elixir Features
body:
After using Elixir for a while, here are my favorite features:

1. Pattern Matching - Makes code incredibly clear
2. The Pipe Operator |> - Transforms nested function calls into readable pipelines
3. Immutability - No more debugging weird side effects
4. OTP - Battle-tested concurrency primitives
5. Documentation - First-class docs with ExDoc

What are your favorite Elixir features?

title: Building CLI Applications
body:
Command-line applications are a great way to learn a new language.

Elixir makes it easy with:
- escript for building executables
- IO module for user input
- Pattern matching for command parsing
- Mix for project management

BlogEngine itself is a great example of what you can build!

title: Organizing Your Blog with Tags
body:
Tags are a powerful way to organize your posts.

Tips for effective tagging:
- Use consistent tag names
- Don't over-tag (3-5 tags per post is good)
- Think about categories (topics, types, series)
- Use the 'tags' command to see all your tags
- Use 'tag <name>' to filter posts

Happy blogging!
